description: Welcome to Edgar Suites.Want to stay in a unique apartment? This pretty Urban Suite, located in the heart of historic Paris, is a duplex apartment on the 3rd floor of a 17th century private mansion with a ceiling classified as a Historic Monument. An establishment ideally located in the heart of the capital which consists of 10 top-of-the-range accommodation carefully renovated by the Edgar Suites teams.The Edgar Suites teams look forward to welcoming you. :)The spaceThis Suite Urbaine is a fully equipped apartment. Ideal for a family or a group, it will charm you with its very Parisian design.Each room has its own air conditioning.This comfortable room can welcome up to 6 people with its 3 bedrooms and their private bathrooms. The first room has a king-size bed (180cm x 200cm), the second bedroom has a queen-size bed (160cm x 200cm), and the third has 2 single beds (90cm x 190cm).Enjoy a spacious apartment, a quality bedding, storage spaces, linens, towels and Rituals toiletries.The Suite Urbaine has a fully equipped kitchen furnished with:- A Nespresso coffee machine and pods- A kettle and tea bags- Microwave- Dishwasher- Washing machine/Dryer- Toaster...In the basement, you will have access to a washing machine and a dryer.Guest accessTravelers will have access to the entire apartment.
